regime_context: Canada/TSX shows Big Banks as the dominant theme with strong breadth (1.0) and durability (0.72), but it is crowded. The one-narrative flag is false, indicating a more balanced rotation with no confirmed leadership handoff. The absolute trend gate is effective (gate_helps true), making eligibility a risk-control filter.

theses.subject: Silver & Royalties
theses.thesis: Silver & Royalties is ineligible under the absolute trend gate, with very low durability (0.25) and narrow breadth (0.167). The only validated edge of the detector is drawdown and shake-out avoidance via the trend gate. Avoiding or underweighting this theme reduces exposure to tail risk, consistent with the detector's risk-control discipline.
theses.dissent: A geopolitical or monetary shock could suddenly boost precious metals, making the theme rally despite poor trend structure.

falsifier.text: The theme becomes eligible (trend gate flips true) and durability rises above 0.5 with broadening breadth.

theses.subject: Utilities & Renewables
theses.thesis: Utilities & Renewables is eligible and exhibits a balanced trend profile: moderate durability (0.65), high breadth (0.846), and it is not crowded. The trend gate suggests the theme is in a stable uptrend that historically limits drawdowns. In a risk-controlled Canada portfolio, overweighting this non-crowded, broad-based trend may provide a smoother ride without relying on momentum return forecasts.
theses.dissent: The Hurst exponent is mixed, indicating some trend fragility. Rising bond yields or a rotation back into cyclical sectors could erode the trend.

falsifier.text: Breadth falls below 0.6 or durability drops below 0.5, or the theme loses eligibility.

macro_narrative.note: market-level macro/policy/geo narrative flow; coincident, not per-theme, never a trigger
